text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The Facilities Management Division is recommending that the parkland located within the East York Civic Centre complex at 850 Coxwell Avenue (lands fronting Coxwell Avenue between Memorial Park Avenue to the North and Mortimer Avenue to the South) be officially named "Memorial Gardens Park". The Facilities Management Division and the Parks, Forestry and Recreation Division have reviewed the policy criteria in the Council-approved City of Toronto Property Naming Policy and verify that the proposed park name meets the criteria.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Officially named the park within the East York Civic Centre Complex at 850 Coxwell Avenue "Memorial Gardens Park".
